review.name: Frost Wyrm
findings: Fresh complete-face/body source inspection confirms jaw shear during recoil and defeat and muzzle elongation during attack/cast. All 216 actual equipped-technique frames inspected front/side; arms, legs, back spines and tail remain connected. Correct the lower-face binding, preserving the sculpt and every original curve. Check beard loop and neck transition in the separate candidate before promotion.

Complete-face jaw repair v2 protects chest seams and includes the separate beard loop. Nine isolated tail-root correction tracks clear independently frozen visible tail points in all 12 standing clips at 481 times each; authored body/feet/other-tail/death curves remain exact. The jaw-only v2 candidate was rejected after actual technique review found tail-floor clipping. All 12 raw jaw-plus-tail candidate slices and 216 actual-technique frames were actually inspected and pass.

All 12 candidate raw slices and 216 actual technique frames actually inspected and pass. Final second pass: all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, 32 production transition slices at low/medium, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 actual equipped-technique frames and all 16 atlas cells actually inspected and pass. Original geometry, topology, UVs, textures and rig preserved. Every authored animation curve preserved; nine isolated tail-root rotation tracks added to clear the floor. No model reduction was required beyond regenerating the existing battle LOD. Local only; whole-roster/main/live release remain pending.

companionTechniqueAudit.finding: All nine actual equipped techniques inspected front/side at twelve times each. Jaw, eyes, muzzle spikes and the separate beard loop stay aligned. Neck blends continuously into the protected chest; arms, legs and tail stay connected throughout strike, cast, guard and recovery. The corrected visible tail clears the floor in actual technique windup and recovery.
